products.body_html:
"The man that never made a fuckup never made fuck all."

CONSTRUCTION NOTE: in the interest of trying new things, i've experimented with a tri-colour ribbon that's been sewn on. so full disclosure: i play golf with it no worries at all. BUT - please note the ribbon is not elastic. i cannot stress this enough, a golf swing for me in it is fine and i wear L polo when realistically i should be XL. so no dramas for me otherwise i wouldn't be selling it. but i do feel compelled to at least be more than upfront with it. either way, if ya ain't 100% happy with my experiment, let me know and ill sort it out. appreciate the leap of faith amigos!

products.title: vibes cotton polo
products.body_html:
"It is much easier to be fired for being illogical than it is for being unimaginative. The fatal issue is that logic always gets you to exactly the same place as your competitors."

CONSTRUCTION NOTE: in the interest of trying new things, i've experimented a bit with this one. 3 piece cotton consutruction (navy, white, then navy again), with care to avoid seams around the nipple area (i'm a sensitive guy ok). the teal and pink highlights have been screen printed onto the white to avoid making this a gajillion seamed monster that would chafe you to shreds. i wouldn;'t wear it and sell it if i didn't 100% believe in it, so if ya ain't 100% happy with my experiment, let me know and ill sort it out. appreciate the understadning brochachos.

products.title: navy nylon shorts
products.body_html:
"depression can’t hit a moving target"

my new daily drivers

100% nylon. silky yet sturdy. put it this way, i play golf in em, i go beach with em, i wear them all day. i just don't go for runs wearing em.

elastic waist with drawstring

embroidered logo on front left and okka "O" above back pocket

2 side pockets (enough to fit an ereader for my performative friends) and a rear right pocket

note: hip circumference refers to the waistband across the top at full stretch. length refers to the top of the waistband down to the bottom of the short. 
for reference, i'm roughly 191cm tall and 95kg, with a ~104cm lower waist (where the top of my shorts sit) and i wear an XL.
